en.title: Sleep & Stress
en.who: Guests who mark trouble falling asleep, waking at 3 am, waking up unrefreshed, stressed all day and wired at night, jet lag, or stress that goes to the stomach.
studyWhy: the liver, and why sleep routes through it

say: Do you ever have a day so stressful that you can't fall asleep, and then the bad night makes the next day even worse?
feel.tip: Say back what they marked, in their words. Then ask: "Is it falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up tired?"

say: Honestly, I've been there. [Your story in a line or two: when it was, what it felt like, what you tried that didn't work.]
felt.tip: Your own story, or someone close to you ("my mom", "a friend from work"). No story yet? "A lot of the people I talk to say exactly the same thing." Never make one up.

say: What I learned is that stress and sleep feed each other, so you work on both: calm the stress during the day, and give the body what it needs to switch off at night.
So this is what I'd start with.
found.tip: One or two sentences from Part A, then the routine. Pick the products that match what they marked.

en.ask: Based on what you told me, I'd start with the magnesium, the ashwagandha and the B vitamins. Do you want to take it home tonight?
en.doctor: Loud snoring, pauses in breathing, or trouble sleeping most nights for three months? See a doctor first. Never change sleeping pills or antidepressants without the doctor. Pregnant or breastfeeding: no ashwagandha.
know: Stress and sleep feed each other.
A stressful day makes it hard to fall asleep, and the bad night makes the next day even more stressful. That's why you work on both sides at once.
Your stress alarm should switch off at night.
Cortisol is meant to be high in the morning and low at bedtime. When it's still on, you're tired but your head keeps going, like a smoke alarm still beeping after the toast is out.
Calm is made from nutrients.

The brain builds its calming signals, GABA and serotonin, with magnesium and the B vitamins, and stress burns through both. It's not only in your head: the body runs short on what it needs to calm down.
The gut is your second brain.
Hundreds of millions of nerve cells line the gut and talk to the brain all day, in both directions. That's why a deadline lands in your stomach, and why a stressed gut can keep you up.
Waking at 3 am usually starts at dinner.
A late, heavy dinner or a few drinks keep the liver on the night shift. You drop off fine, but as it wears off, sleep turns light.
Melatonin is a clock signal, not a sleeping pill.
It tells the body night has started. On average it gets people to sleep about seven minutes sooner, so it's for jet lag and a shifted schedule, not every night.
Sleep runs in 90-minute cycles.
Wake in the middle of deep sleep and you feel awful even after a full night. A 7 am alarm means aiming to be asleep around 11:30 pm.
The free half of the plan.
Last coffee before 2 pm, phone out of the bedroom, dinner three hours before bed, and the same wake time seven days a week.
routine: Ashwagandha, plus Magnesium (or Cal Mag D)
A cup of Chamomile Tea, lights down, phone out of the bedroom
Sleep Health or Sleep Gummies, 30 to 60 minutes before bed

zh.title: 睡眠与压力
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了入睡难、半夜三点醒、睡够了还是没精神、白天发蔫晚上精神、倒时差，或者一紧张胃就不舒服的客人。
studyWhy: 肝，以及为什么睡眠问题要从肝入手

say: 你有没有过这种时候：白天压力特别大，晚上怎么都睡不着，结果没睡好，第二天更难熬？
feel.tip: 用对方自己的话，把问卷上勾的说回去。然后问一句：“是睡不着、睡不稳，还是醒来还很累？”

say: 说实话，我也经历过。[你的故事，一两句就好：什么时候、什么感觉、试过什么没用。]
felt.tip: 讲你自己的，或者身边人的（“我妈妈”“我一个同事”）。还没有故事？就说：“我身边很多朋友也是这样。”千万别编。

say: 我后来学到，压力和睡眠是互相加码的，所以要两边一起调：白天把压力降下来，晚上给身体它关机需要的东西。
所以，我会先从这个开始。
found.tip: 从 Part A 挑一两句讲，然后讲作息。挑跟对方勾的对得上的产品。

zh.ask: 按你刚才说的，我建议先从镁、南非醉茄和B族这三样开始。今天要不要先带回去？
zh.doctor: 打鼾很响、睡眠中有呼吸暂停，或者连续三个月大多数晚上都睡不好？请先去看医生。安眠药、抗抑郁药一定要在医生指导下调整。怀孕或哺乳期不吃南非醉茄。
groups: 调生物钟（只在偶尔的晚上）
know: 压力和睡眠会互相加码。
白天压力大，晚上就难睡着；晚上没睡好，第二天压力更大。所以要两边一起调。
身体的压力警报，晚上本该关掉。
皮质醇应该早上高、睡前低。睡前它还开着，人很累，脑子却停不下来，就像吐司早就拿出来了，烟雾报警器还在响。
平静是用营养素做出来的。
大脑靠镁和B族，合成GABA、血清素这些让人平静的信号，而压力会把这两样都耗掉。所以不只是想太多，身体里平静下来的原料也不够了。
肠道是人的第二个大脑。
肠道里有好几亿个神经细胞，整天跟大脑双向通话。所以事情一赶胃就先打结，肠胃不舒服也会让人睡不好。
半夜三点醒，问题常常出在晚饭。
晚饭吃得太晚太重、喝了几杯，肝就得上夜班。刚开始睡得着，等劲儿过去，睡眠就变浅了。
褪黑素是时钟信号，不是安眠药。
它告诉身体“天黑了”。平均只能让人早七分钟左右睡着，所以适合倒时差、作息乱了的时候，不是每晚吃。
睡眠是90分钟一个周期。
闹钟正好响在深睡中间，睡够了起来也难受。早上7点的闹钟，最好晚上11点半左右就睡着。
方案里免费的那一半。
咖啡下午两点前喝完，手机不进卧室，晚饭离睡觉三小时，一周七天同一时间起床。
routine: 南非醉茄，加镁片（或钙镁D）
一杯洋甘菊茶，灯调暗，手机不进卧室
安睡片或甜梦软糖，睡前30到60分钟
